hypothesis.evidence: Waiting: automated search done (92 of 355 trials, 25.9%, with no results found); the hand-checked sample has not been drawn yet.

hypothesis.text: H002: Results go missing less often since the 2017 US reporting rule
hypothesis.evidence: No results found for 24.6% of trials completed since the 2017 rule (29/118) vs 26.6% before (63/237); one-sided p = 0.393.
